criteria: every row whose producer bilingualRelation is not PARALLEL
deterministic 10% sample of all remaining producer no-leak rows
selectionRule.sampleHash: sha256 of the UTF-8 sample key
selectionRule.sampleInclusion: include when the first unsigned byte of the digest modulo 10 equals 0
selectionRule.note: Criteria are disjunctive; a row selected by any criterion is selected. The 10% sample is applied only to rows not already selected by criteria 1-3.

p26Note: Per DECISIONS.md P26 the exclusion boundary is itself published: all 192 excluded rows are producer no-leak rows carrying full sample-key derivation below, so the suppressed surface is mechanically auditable rather than asserted.
